verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own "custom rules" feature in its transaction-categorization help collection. Its startup page also says busywork is "described once, done automatically," which suggests user-defined automation. The evidence is only a help-article title plus marketing copy, and the rules appear limited to categorizing transactions rather than general event-triggered actions. Missing for 10: documented rule conditions and event triggers, a range of available actions beyond categorization, details of how rules execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final
